path_rule: Original-record paths are relative to topic; external catalog paths starting topics/ are repository-relative.
scope: Retire only the exact189 generated descriptive JSON files listed in delete_entries from the active topic tree. Keep all original numerical states, checkpoints, full responses, matrices, step/field evidence, original configs/specs/requests, scientific sources, proofs, active materials, canonical live identities, parent91 and every unresolved ports/Nelder object.

complete_metadata_lookup.window_identity: window-parameters.records[*].original_record.path; merge its common_fields_by_kind[kind] and shared_stage_parameter_rows[index]. All144 complete original objects are represented.
complete_metadata_lookup.tailclient: client-parameters.rows[*].original_record.path; merge common_fields and fields, with common_source_sha256+fields.source_sha256. All32 full original objects and the retained original input/runtime config records are present.
complete_metadata_lookup.condensed: condensed-parameters-a has the common full field/source tables and first6 full rows; part-b references that exact record and supplies the remaining7 full rows. Each row has complete request fields, full ordered verified-source indices, raw-request SHA provenance and original complete workflow/outcome catalog pointer.

classification.window_descriptions: Read whole144 small files. They are written before their actual window integration and contain scalar/address parameters and source identities, not the full226 states, local Jacobian or field/stage numerical report. Every parameter value/hex word and full source-patch text is retained in the normalized complete parameter table.
classification.client_descriptions: Read whole32 small files. The original19526-byte TailClient writes these ten-field identities before Popen. All32 complete runtime configs and all32 matching original input-config identities were read and matched; original config files remain unchanged. The command is a pre-Popen base command, not silently relabeled as any later hook-augmented actual command.
classification.request_wrappers: Read whole13 wrappers and all13 complete original workflow sources. Exact common pre-science writer body, one wrapper occurrence per workflow. Every original request and ordered source verification field is preserved, including all original budgets. Full mathematical producers, parent warm/status, input files, numeric outcomes and original request bytes remain in existing catalogs/fixed history.

original_readers_and_restoration.actual41_reader: exact_20261114_rawcell0_step_system.py reads report.identity by full descriptor; direct-LD capture also compares all original window parameters. Restore the original file bytes before these unchanged readers.
original_readers_and_restoration.native_history_reader: exact_20261114_seeded_zero_tail_client.py and geometry_20261114_zero_rk_native_probe.py read actual old intent and compare source/config/command identities. Restore the exact original intent; the new normalized table is not an alternate file accepted by those guards.
original_readers_and_restoration.condensed_history: Prior retention41/30 and historical readers may refer to wrapper paths/digests. They continue to mean the exact old wrapper; this retention does not alter or alias their identities.
original_readers_and_restoration.exact_bytes: Use fixed_restore_commit:path or the listed Git blob. Verify original byte count and SHA256/Git blob before restoring at the original name. No scientific run is needed to recover these already-published bytes. Recreating serialized JSON from the normalized table is not claimed to reproduce the old raw SHA.

root_application_rule: Immediately before an ordinary commit, root checks every exact path still has the listed Git blob and byte count. Omit/reassess any changed/missing item; never delete a directory/prefix. No agent here wrote a ref, queue or deletion.
